name: Zuul CI Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free and open-source self-managed CI and project-gating service with Ansible jobs, cross-project dependency testing and continuous delivery orchestration; no vendor-imposed build-minute quota.
watch_out: Operators must provide Zuul services, executors, nodepool or other workers, persistent storage and security maintenance. Build resources and external cloud providers may incur charges; follow upstream license obligations.
